slices.label: Aftermath of the great collapse

uncertainties: LEV is one cell holding Phoenicia, Philistia and Israel at once: assigned to phoenician_cities at -1100, to israel_judah -1000..-750, to Assyria -700/-650, to Babylon -600. Tyre/Sidon's continuing autonomy is carried in notes and relations; phoenician_cities as an entity appears only at -1100.
-814 LEV kept with israel_judah though Hazael's Damascus was de facto hegemon; flagged via contestedRegions on both sides.

Urartu's fall is dated anywhere -609..-585 in scholarship; here it is gone by -600 and Media already holds ARM/ARM_W, plus CAP and PON (marked consolidating/contested) although the Halys war with Lydia is -590..-585. This makes the -550 Persia join exact but is ~15 years generous to Media in Anatolia.
BIT at -650/-600 given to Thracian Bithynians; Lydia only takes it under Croesus (matches era03's -550 Lydia holding). Alyattes' Troad campaigns would also support Lydian BIT at -600.
MLT assigned to Carthage from -700: Phoenician settlement there is c. -750..-700, but formal Carthaginian hegemony is 6th century.
BAL assigned to Carthage from -650 on the strength of Ebusus (654); Mallorca/Menorca remained Talaiotic in fact — talaiotic entity ends at -700.
Chernoles culture (UKR_W, -1100..-700) tagged culture-family 'slavic' following the proto-Slavic school; a Thracian attribution also exists.

Cimmerians modelled as territorial holders (HUN at -750/-700 via the Mezocsat/Thraco-Cimmerian horizon; PON -700, PON+CAP -650) though they were a moving horde; their -600 disappearance follows Alyattes' victories.

Kush/egypt split at -750: Kashta's takeover of Thebes (c. 755) shown as Kush holding EGY_S; Delta left to Libyan dynasts. At -700 the 25th Dynasty holds both Egypt regions, so 'egypt' as an entity is absent for that one slice, returning as Saite at -650.

Brief's parenthetical 'at -650 Assyria holds Egypt' contradicts its own 'lost -655'; followed actual chronology — Psamtik I independent by -655/-653, so -650 shows Saite Egypt free and Assyria without Egypt.
SIC assigned wholly to greek_poleis from -700 although the interior stayed Sicel and the west Phoenician (Motya); one-cell resolution.

Founded years kept from era01 for continuity where era03 differs: balts_early -2000 (era03 -1000), finnic/sami -2000 (era03 -1500), nuragic -1800 (era03 -1600), thracians/illyrians -1300 (era03 -1100/-1000).

Phrygia's Gordion destruction is archaeologically re-dated to c. -800 by some (DeVries et al.); the traditional Cimmerian destruction c. -696..-675 is followed here, so Phrygia dies between -700 and -650.
Greek ION coast: region given to Greeks from -1000 (Ionian migration) though the Lydian interior of the cell was Anatolian; Lydia then takes the whole cell from -650.
